question: Dráma Otec získala na cenách Slnko v sieti 2026 ocenenie za najlepší hraný film aj za réžiu a rok predtým vyhrala hlavnú cenu Zlaté oko na festivale v Zürichu. Ktorá slovenská režisérka ju nakrútila?
source_excerpt: dráma Otec režisérky Terezy Nvotovej získala v Zürichu na prestížnom filmovom festivale hlavnú cenu - Zlaté oko

extra.why_interesting: Players remember the film's title and its triumph, but the question tests whether they connect it with the director who is one of the few Slovak filmmakers with a real international profile.

topicality.rationale: Major national film awards result, remembered for about a year.

extra.verification_notes: Otec (Father) directed by Tereza Nvotová won Best Film and Directing at Slnko v sieti 2026 and the Zurich Golden Eye (2025); no contradicting newer info found (https://www.noviny.sk/slovensko/1115311-slovensky-film-otec-boduje-zlate-oko-v-z-richu-a-cesta-na-oscara).

explanation: Nvotová mala s Otcom premiéru na festivale v Benátkach a film reprezentoval Slovensko aj v boji o Oscara za rok 2025.

question: V marci 2026 sa pieseň i was never yours dostala do rebríčka amerického magazínu Billboard, a jej interpretka sa tak stala prvou umelkyňou narodenou na Slovensku, ktorá sa v tomto rebríčku objavila. Ako sa volá?
source_excerpt: Karin Ann is the first artist born in Slovakia to make the Billboard chart (Adult Alternative Airplay, No. 35).

extra.why_interesting: Players assume a veteran pop export would be the first Slovak on a Billboard chart; the answer is a young alternative singer who built her career largely abroad.

topicality.rationale: Historic first Slovak-born artist on Billboard chart, a headline remembered for about a year.

extra.verification_notes: TASR (4 March 2026) reports Karin Ann's song at No. 35 on Billboard Adult Alternative Airplay and calls her the first Slovak-born artist on a Billboard chart; the exact entry month (possibly February) is slightly uncertain.

explanation: Skladba sa umiestnila v rebríčku Adult Alternative Airplay, ktorý sleduje hranosť v amerických rádiách.

question: Album Slovenská strela získal v roku 2026 na českých cenách Anděl ocenenie v kategórii slovenský album roka. Richard Müller ho nahral so skupinou, v ktorej začínal už v osemdesiatych rokoch. Ako sa táto kapela volá?
source_excerpt: Forty years after the cult debut Bioelektrovizia, Richard Müller returns with a new album from the band BANKET.

extra.why_interesting: Everyone knows Richard Müller as a solo star; the twist is that his award-winning 2025 album was a reunion with the band he started out with in the 1980s.

topicality.rationale: Annual music award result, relevant for about a year.

extra.verification_notes: TASR reports Müller won the Anděl Slovak album category with Banket for Slovenská strela at the April 2026 ceremony; Banket is his 1980s band.

explanation: Müller sa s Banketom po rokoch opäť spojil a spoločný album si vyslúžil Anděla v kategórii vyhradenej pre slovenské nahrávky.

question: Festival Pohoda v Trenčíne oslávil v roku 2026 svoj 30. ročník a vypredal sa už v apríli. Ktorá britská kapela, známa tým, že jej členov na verejnosti zastupujú animované postavičky, bola jedným z hlavných headlinerov?
source_excerpt: Making their long-awaited Pohoda debut, Gorillaz will headline Thursday's programme.

extra.why_interesting: The 30th Pohoda was the biggest ever and sold out months ahead; the 'animated band members' foothold lets a casual music fan reason their way to the headliner.

topicality.rationale: Summer festival lineup and anniversary edition, topical for a season.

extra.verification_notes: Pohoda's official site confirms Gorillaz as Thursday headliner of the 30th edition, and Pollstar reports the April sell-out; no cancellation found.

explanation: Jubilejný ročník okrem Gorillaz uzatvárali aj The Prodigy a organizátori pre veľký záujem zvýšili kapacitu festivalu.

question: Pravda alebo nepravda: Slovensko sa v roku 2026 po rokoch vrátilo do súťaže Eurovízia, ktorá sa konala v blízkej Viedni.
source_excerpt: Slovakia: STVR will not participate in the 2026 Eurovision Song Contest

extra.why_interesting: Eurovision 2026 took place in neighbouring Vienna, so many players assume Slovakia used the chance to return; it stayed away.

topicality.rationale: Hinges on this year's Eurovision participation, relevant for about a year.

extra.verification_notes: Slovakia's broadcaster STVR declined to participate in Eurovision 2026 in Vienna (35 countries, Slovakia not among them), so the statement is false and 'Nepravda' is correct; see https://eurovisionireland.net/2025/07/27/%f0%9f%87%b8%f0%9f%87%b0-slovakia-stvr-will-not-participate-in-the-2026-eurovision-song-contest/

explanation: Slovenská televízia svoju účasť nepotvrdila a Slovensko sa ani vo Viedni nepredstavilo, hoci jeho zástupcovia hovorili o možnom návrate v budúcnosti.

question: Približne koľko divákov prišlo za celý rok 2025 do slovenských kín?
source_excerpt: Počet divákov však v roku 2025 klesol na 5.124.620 (5.435.556 v roku 2024).

extra.why_interesting: Players tend to guess that cinema is a dying habit and undershoot; in fact the number of admissions in 2025 was roughly one ticket per inhabitant of Slovakia.

topicality.rationale: Annual box-office attendance stat discussed briefly after its release early in the year.

extra.verification_notes: Slovak cinemas recorded about 5.12 million admissions in 2025 (per ÚFD data in the 2025 audiovisual report, reported by TASR), matching 'asi 5 miliónov'.

explanation: Do slovenských kín prišlo v roku 2025 približne 5,1 milióna divákov, čo je zhruba jedna vstupenka na každého obyvateľa krajiny.

question: SuperStar sa v septembri 2026 po päťročnej prestávke vrátila na obrazovky Markízy a Novy. V porote sedela aj speváčka z Těšínska s poľskými koreňmi, ktorá sa ako tínedžerka preslávila hitom Měls mě vůbec rád. Ako sa volá?
source_excerpt: Ewa returns to the SuperStar jury

extra.why_interesting: The revived show put a former teenage pop sensation in the judge's chair; the stem's footholds (Polish roots, Těšín region, the breakthrough hit) lead a casual viewer straight to her name.

topicality.rationale: SuperStar comeback and its jury are a seasonal talking point while the show airs.

extra.verification_notes: Ewa Farna is confirmed on the 2026 SuperStar jury (with Habera, Prachař, Calin) on her official site; the show returned to Nova/Markíza after five years and no newer event overturns this.

explanation: Farna, ktorá sama stála na pódiách už od trinástich rokov, hodnotila súťažiacich spolu s hercom Jakubom Prachařom a raperom Calinom.
